description: Presidential Secretariat - Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) - Errata
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of errata corrections to legal regulations (specifically the Emergency (Miscellaneous Provisions and Powers) Regulations No. 1 of 2019). It contains detailed corrections to legal wording, definitions, and procedural matters within existing regulations, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for legal amendments and modifications to statutory instruments.
